source_cards.title: DiffusionRIR: Room Impulse Response Interpolation using Diffusion Models
source_cards.family_relation: foundational method for SRC-ML-20260922-1500-02; not independent evidence
reported_results: approximately 3-7 dB NMSE improvement over spatial cubic interpolation
performance degrades with curvature and toward endfire
limitations: no documented parent-RIR, room-geometry or source-position-disjoint split
correlated patches from eight parent images
no measured-room, listening, localization, phase/mono, peak, long-tail or music test

source_cards.revision: inherits foundational normalization, overlap/reassembly and artifact gaps; measured RIR reconstruction and simulated speech beamforming remain separate claims
source_cards.independence: same method family and authors; not an independent replication

knowledge_cards.claim: The foundational and follow-up DiffusionRIR papers form one evidence family, not independent confirmation.
176 overlapping patches from eight parent RIR images are correlated samples, not 176 independent rooms.
Source-position- and room-geometry-disjoint evaluation is not documented; material, T60 and array geometry shifts are narrower.
Training on 128 ms and applying tiled patches to 256 ms does not establish learned long-context decay.
Per-patch normalization removes absolute scale; inverse scaling for missing patches needs a causal observable definition.
Using missing-target energy for rescaling would be oracle assistance; the paper does not resolve this ambiguity.
Hard centre cropping of overlap is not evidence of seamless reconstruction without boundary residuals.
Duplicated-column padding can introduce a false spatial prior and needs an ablation.
Random masks do not establish robustness to contiguous gaps or one-sided extrapolation.
NMSE/CD gains over one spline baseline do not establish localization, phase safety, peaks, preference or music utility.
MeshRIR is rights-cleared 48 kHz measured data, but an 8 kHz/256 ms subset cannot support full-band or long-tail claims.
Without code, checkpoint, configuration and split artifacts, a clean-room implementation is not validation of the authors' artifact.

handoff: Treat DiffusionRIR as a research candidate, not a renderer. Resolve causal patch scaling first; group splits by parent RIR and source/room provenance; keep overlap, padding, mask topology and seed explicit. Use raw full-band outputs for gain, phase, peak and seam checks and separate loudness-matched copies only for blind listening.
